info.title: TactiDose Well-being Check-in API
info.description:
Optional, informal well-being check-in for the TactiDose prototype.

* Not a clinical assessment. No scores, diagnoses or inferences are produced.
* Never affects medication schedules, dispensing or hardware.
* The host owns microphones, speech recognition, text-to-speech and UI. Send text, play `speech_text`.
* The authenticated user comes from the configured identity provider, never from the request body.

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: Free text (typed or transcribed). Required for action=answer.

note_text.title: Note Text
note_text.description: Optional explanation in the user's own words. Required for action=add_note.

expected_step.title: Expected Step
expected_step.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency guard: the `step` from the last response.

question_id.description: Optional guard: the question this input is meant for.

speech_text.title: Speech Text
speech_text.description: Text for the host's text-to-speech, for this user only.

record_id.title: Record Id
record_id.description: Set once a record was saved.

event_id.title: Event Id
event_id.description: Deterministic; identical on retries. Deduplicate by this.

EventOut.title: EventOut
EventOut.description: A fact the host may act on. NOT proof that anyone was notified.

PendingInputOut.title: PendingInputOut
PendingInputOut.description: Unconfirmed input. Shown for confirmation; never saved as-is.

ShareableRecord.title: ShareableRecord
ShareableRecord.description: Only what the user explicitly allowed to be shared. Empty by default.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: Optional. If present it must equal the authenticated user, otherwise the request is rejected. It is never used as proof of identity.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: This prototype does not reliably detect crises and does not monitor users.
